title: Immunoprecipitation Assay
author: Ning Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zgbf3sn

steps.title: Remove media and rinse cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate culture media and rinse the cells with ice‑cold 1× PBS.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Discard PBS, add 0.5 mL ice‑cold cell lysis buffer to each 10 cm plate, and incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Lyse cells (native/denatured)
steps.instruction: Lyse the harvested cells using the chosen condition.

substeps.instruction: Native: Scrape cells into microcentrifuge tubes, keep on ice, and sonicate on ice three times for 5 s each.
Denatured: Scrape cells into a 2.5 mL tube, boil for 10 min, then add four volumes of cell lysis buffer to obtain the lysate.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin lysates at 14,000 g for 10 min at 4 °C, transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add the primary antibody (at the dilution recommended by the manufacturer) to 200 µL of lysate containing 1 mg/mL protein, then rock gently overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Add protein A/G beads
steps.instruction: Add 10–30 µL of 50 % protein A/G agarose bead slurry to the antibody‑lysate mixture and incubate with gentle rocking for 1–3 h at 4 °C.

steps.title: Collect and wash immune complexes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 4 °C for 30 s, discard supernatant, and wash the bead pellet five times with 500 µL ice‑cold cell lysis buffer, keeping the tube on ice between washes.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in sample buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed bead pellet in 20 µL SDS sample buffer, vortex briefly, and centrifuge 30 s.

steps.title: Heat (optional) and spin sample
steps.instruction: Heat the sample at 95–100 °C for 5 min (optional), then centrifuge 1 min at 14,000 g; if not heating, proceed directly to centrifugation.

steps.title: Load sample onto SDS‑PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Load the prepared sample onto a 4–20 % gradient SDS‑PAGE gel for electrophoresis.
